title: Aegis Install Manifest
x_note: Machine-readable twin of aegis/INSTALL.md — a fresh AI executor can iterate `phases` in order, run each step by `actor`, and verify `check` before advancing. Prose rationale lives in INSTALL.md; this is the executable spine. actor: AI = executor runs it; PM = human gate, STOP and ask.

actors.PM: human-only gate: STOP, state need, wait

conventions.on_check_fail: STOP; report the failing check verbatim; never loosen a check to proceed

ts_from_env.description: timestamp taken from the environment, not invented

phases.title: Preconditions

steps.cmd: pip install pyyaml jsonschema pyarrow pandas --break-system-packages
steps.note: pyarrow/pandas only if reseeding the historical store

phases.check: git + python3 present AND >=2 of {FMP,Drive} connectors resolvable

steps.cmd: git clone https://github.com/TongIncomeWheel/AQE.git  # or: git -C AQE pull

phases.title: Build packages
phases.check: dist/claude-plugin/aegis-v4/agents/ has 12 files (10 voice-* + committee-desk + staging-gatekeeper); Kimi build (if run) excludes staging-gatekeeper; D-45 self-heal layer present in the package: tools/{notify,self_heal,ops_status}.py, skills/{ops-status,recover}/SKILL.md, contracts/{self_heal,ops_status}.schema.json -- these are tools/skills NOT agents, so agent count stays 12

phases.title: Config & secrets

steps.gate: FMP_API_KEY + GitHub token into gitignored aegis/config/.env (copy env.example)

steps.note: D-46: PILOT notifications are Cowork-NATIVE (notifications.channel=cowork) -- nothing to configure. WhatsApp/WATCHDOG_URL secrets are POST-MIGRATION (local box/Kimi) only; leave blank for the pilot, do NOT wire them

phases.check: fund_config.allocated_capital() is a number; git check-ignore aegis/config/.env returns path; no secret in tracked files

phases.title: Data bridge & shelf

steps.cmd: python3 -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('aegis/contracts/*.json')]"

steps.do: pull today's AQE export (validate vs aqe_export.schema.json; run tools/tripwires.py) and latest Aegis PTJ from RB:data_sources.ptj.drive_folder_id

phases.check: historical n_tickers>500; tripwires PASS; dyncap get_dyncap() non-null AND marked_asof==today

phases.title: Install as running workspace

steps.do: package aegis/dist/claude-plugin/aegis-v4/ into a .plugin file and deliver to PM

steps.gate: HARD PLATFORM GATE: open the delivered .plugin file in the Cowork DESKTOP app and install it (replaces/supersedes any older plugin build live on the account). A remote/cloud container CANNOT install a plugin -- no /mnt/.local-plugins or /mnt/.plugins mount exists there; do not attempt a workaround.

steps.do: Kimi only: register voice subagents from aegis-agent.yaml (no desktop-only constraint on this path)

phases.check: a skill loads AND both /fa AND /ops (D-45 liveness) render from state without error, confirmed against the NEWLY installed plugin (check skill/version, not just that a plugin responds); /ops shows the channel as cowork-native (D-46 pilot default) -- only a first-run/git-head PARTIAL is expected, not a channel problem

phases.title: Standing clock (scheduled tasks)

steps.note: app scheduler, NOT in-process cron; each fires a fresh session that pulls->runs->commits

D-46 PILOT: enable each loop task's notifications:{push:true} so run_ok/run_fail rides the Cowork NATIVE push. OPTIONAL pre-run heartbeat task: notify.py pre_run before each key run. The external watchdog + Windows schtasks/batch in NOTIFICATIONS_SETUP.md are POST-MIGRATION (local box) ONLY -- not wired on Cowork

phases.check: list_triggers shows the loop tasks (and any optional heartbeat) with push notifications enabled; NO external watchdog is required on the Cowork pilot

phases.title: Smoke test / UAT

steps.do: one SUPERVISED premarket run -> schema-valid plan, 10 nomination files, committee.json, sizing+gates vs live dynCap
forced-failure: tripwire block stands down + pages; gatekeeper refuses a no-consensus dummy and logs it

D-45/D-46 self-heal UAT (Cowork-native): /ops renders and shows channel=cowork-native; notify.py run_fail --dry-run failure page is visibly distinct; a run_ok/pre_run emits the message that rides the scheduled-task push (confirm a test task's push reaches the phone); self_heal.py --failure ptj_pull => healed, --failure tripwire => stand_down/not healed; confirm /heal /recover /repull /reseed cannot place an order (execution still previews at the gate). SKIP the external-watchdog check -- POST-MIGRATION only

phases.check: DEPLOY.md section C acceptance checklist passes item-by-item AND the D-45 self-heal UAT passes each item; results written to install_state.json

phases.title: Go-live gating

steps.gate: then /arm within RB:autopilot caps (<=1R, <=3/session, 05:30 SGT expiry, preauthorised only); one deployment armed at a time

phases.check: NONE — installer STOPS here; arming is the PM's decision, never automated
